title: Credential / ID card: a condensed mission name, an emblem slot, a number, typed name and organisation on rules with small geometric labels, a rubber stamp
use: Badges, passes, tickets, name cards, membership cards.

paper.note: aged sheet from materials generate --generator paper (ground layer: sampled for contrast); empty draws the flat ink

emblem.note: mark slot for the owner's logo, insignia or emblem file (PNG or SVG with alpha), placed with fit contain; square, 0.17 W, between the name and the number; keep clear space of 0.15 of its side; never drawn by the template

relations: Mission name and number at 0.27 H, the emblem between them.
Two typed lines on rules at 0.62 and 0.86 H, labels under the rules.

provenance.corpus: atomic-age kit (Halcyon Orbital Lines): our own original world in the atomic-age grammar, examples/atomic-age-kit
provenance.experiment: styles/atomic-age/style.json provenance (owner-supplied mood board measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: k-means palette (6 clusters, OKLab-free RGB on a 160 px reduction), light and dark shares, visual-weight centre and proportions read on the board's credential panel
